parents.subject: Information Sciences
parents.course: Advanced Topics in Ethics and Privacy

ns2:section.sectionText: Examines intellectual freedom issues throughout the United States and the world. Approaches intellectual freedom as an ethical issue based in interpretations of the First Amendment and the United Nations Declaration of Human Rights. The course encourages information professionals to view commitment to intellectual freedom as a core professional value and gives students the opportunity to develop skills and strategies needed to navigate censorship controversies in the workplace. Graduate student questions may be sent to ischool-advising@illinois.edu
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Information Sciences or Illinois Informatics Institute department.
